python3.12 - <<'PY'
from solution import load_people
import csv
import io

header = 'name,email,age,active\\n'
checks = 0

def valid(text, expected):
    global checks
    assert load_people(text) == expected, repr(text)
    checks += 1

def invalid(text):
    global checks
    try:
        load_people(text)
    except ValueError:
        checks += 1
    else:
        raise AssertionError(repr(text))

person = dict(name='Sam', email='sam@example.invalid', age=30, active=True)
valid('\\ufeff'+header+'Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,true\\n', [person])
valid(' active , age , email , name \\r\\n TRUE ,030, SAM@EXAMPLE.INVALID , Sam \\r\\n', [person])
valid(header+'\"Sam, A\\r\\nB \"\"C\"\"\",sam@example.invalid,,false\\n', [dict(name='Sam, A\\r\\nB \"C\"', email='sam@example.invalid', age=None, active=False)])
valid(header+'\\n , , \\n,,,,,,\\n\"  \",\"\\n\"\\n', [])
valid(header, [])
for token, value in [('true', True), ('TRUE', True), ('1', True), ('false', False), ('FaLsE', False), ('0', False), ('', False)]:
    valid(header+f'Sam,sam@example.invalid,,{token}', [dict(person, age=None, active=value)])
for age in ['0','130','00030','0'*5000+'30']:
    valid(header+f'Sam,sam@example.invalid,{age},1', [dict(person, age=int(age.lstrip('0') or '0'))])
for text in ['', '\\ufeff', '\\n', 'name,email,age\\n', 'name,email,age,active,extra\\n', 'name,email,age,name\\n', '\\ufeff\\ufeff'+header]:
    invalid(text)
for row in ['Sam,sam@example.invalid,30', 'Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,true,x', ',sam@example.invalid,30,true']:
    invalid(header+row)
for email in ['', 'sam', '@example.invalid', 'sam@', 's@m@x', 's a@m', 's@a\\tb', 's@a\\u2003b']:
    invalid(header+f'Sam,{email},30,true')
for age in ['-1', '+1', '1.0', '١', '１２', '131', '9999', '1 2', '9'*5000]:
    invalid(header+f'Sam,sam@example.invalid,{age},true')
for active in ['yes','no','2','truth']:
    invalid(header+f'Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,{active}')
for text in ['\"name,email,age,active', header+'Sa\"m,sam@example.invalid,30,true', header+'\"Sam\"x,sam@example.invalid,30,true', header+'\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,true', header+'\"Sam\" ,sam@example.invalid,30,true']:
    invalid(text)
invalid(header+'Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,true\\nJo,invalid,20,1')
# Exercise the quote validator against standard-library serialization.
for name in ['Sam', 'Sam, Jo', 'Sam\\nJo', 'Sam\\rJo', 'Sam\"Jo', '\"', 'Sam\\r\\nJo']:
    buffer = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.writer(buffer)
    writer.writerow(['name','email','age','active'])
    writer.writerow([name,'SAM@EXAMPLE.INVALID','30','true'])
    valid(buffer.getvalue(), [dict(person, name=name)])
print(f'{checks} supplemental checks passed')
PY
